entries.reasoning: AtliQ assigned all intellectual property rights in IngestIQ to Novaterra Energy Ltd under a perpetual assignment and agreed not to use, copy, license, or deliver services using IngestIQ for any third party. The new contract requires AtliQ to deploy IngestIQ and grant a licence to Aldergrove while warranting ownership.

incomingClauses.quote: To accelerate delivery, the Supplier will deploy its proven IngestIQ ingestion and data-quality framework (a pre-existing Supplier Material), already used in production for a UK energy retailer's half-hourly smart-meter data.

The Supplier retains ownership of Supplier Materials and grants Aldergrove a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free, non-exclusive licence to use, modify and maintain any Supplier Materials incorporated in the Deliverables.
The Supplier warrants that it owns, or has all rights necessary to license, all Supplier Materials, and that their use by Aldergrove will not infringe any third party's rights.

entries.suggestedChange: Remove all references to IngestIQ from Schedule 1 and replace it with a bespoke data ingestion component or an alternative unencumbered framework, adjusting project pricing and milestones accordingly.
entries.impact: Collides with the perpetual assignment of IngestIQ to Novaterra Energy Ltd.
